title: Build a Zylo alternative with Claude: free SaaS spend tracker spec, 31/31 checks passed
description:
Claude built a Zylo alternative from one Markdown spec: all 31 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 99 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 6 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a SaaS spend tracker for companies of 10 to 200 people and had it build the tool in four phases: people, departments and settings; the inventory, money rules and department totals; renewals, status changes and reminders; and CSV import and export. The core rule: the notice deadline is the renewal date minus the contract's notice period, and the tool's owner is reminded 30 days before that deadline, not before the renewal. The gaps included people who could be deactivated but never reactivated, restoring a cancelled tool whose owner had since left, and a late cancellation that had no place in the history. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when Zylo is still the better buy.
